With a rich theoretical knowledge, a student base that contains not only “regular” players but also some absolute stellar names in the industry, and a pair of ears that are completely unforgiving he has never been able to locate a pedal he can use that allows him to be the guitarist he truly is. When we first met Tom in early 2012, he was already using our Euphoria and Paisley Drive stacked together to give him the tones he required. But, something wasn’t quite right; those pedals are kinda voiced for other genres of music altogether so we set about honing the tones to match his style of playing. sources.excerpt: Wampler Pedals Tom Quayle: Dual Fusion | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Wampler Pedals Tom Quayle: Dual Fusion Tom Quayle: Dual Fusion The Wampler Pedals Dual Fusion is a versatile overdrive pedal designed in collaboration with guitarist Tom Quayle, specifically for fusion music. It offers two independent circuits, based on the Euphoria and Paisley Drive , providing a wide range of tones suitable for various genres. With its transparent sound and tight low-end response, the Dual Fusion aims to emulate the feel of a high-gain amplifier, offering clarity and responsiveness. It's designed to be the foundation of modern fusion, and appeal to guitarists of all genres.
